newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Weather - Scattered showers seen over Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Weather - Scattered showers seen over Sri Lanka.

text.p: Sri Lanka's metereological department forecast scattered, light showers in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern and Central provinces and Kurunegala district for Wednesday.
It said in a statement on Tuesday that isloated thundershowers are likely in the Uva and eastern provinces during Wednesday afternoon and evening.
Fairly strong winds will continue over the western slope of Central hills, it added.
